name: WRIST ACTION SHAKER
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-WASK-810 Wrist Action Shaker is a robust laboratory shaking machine meticulously designed to imitate the back-and-forth shaking action of a human wrist. This heavy-duty instrument is highly utilized in chemistry, agricultural, and extraction laboratories for vigorously blending solvents and dissolving stubborn solids inside Erlenmeyer flasks.
features: High-torque heavy duty motor mechanism for robust shaking
Accommodates 4 or 8 flasks with capacities from 100ml to 500ml
Rotary speed regulator to precisely control wrist action agitation
Steel rod shaft fitted with clamps and rubber sleeves for a secure flask grip
0 – 99 minutes digital or mechanical timer options for continuous runs

specifications.Clamp Mechanism: Steel rods with rubber sleeves for easy grip
specifications.Target Applications: Solvent Blending, Solid Dissolution, Chemical Extraction procedures
